# Data Science: Tier 3: Advanced Engineering, Research and System Design

> **The question this tier answers:** Can you take on an ambiguous, substantial problem, make research-informed decisions, run rigorous experiments, and defend the trade-offs?

See [tier definitions](../../../docs/tier-definitions.md) for the full competency description, and [how to choose an assessment](../../../docs/member-handbook.md).

## Units at this tier

### DS-01: Python and Data Wrangling

_Not offered at this tier._ Tier 3 is not offered. Advanced wrangling is assessed inside DS-11 (pipelines) and DS-12 (research), where it serves a purpose instead of being an end in itself.
